vulnerability_summary: OpenClaw allowed a sandboxed session to cross-spawn into an agent configured with sandbox.mode=off.
causality: Human atomic commit 0ba72477 introduced cross-agent sessions_spawn: it selected targetAgentId from agentId, applied only allowAgents, and created the child under that target without comparing requester and child sandbox runtimes. The vulnerable cross-agent behavior therefore existed from 2026-01-08. Claude-coauthored commit 49dffa40 later extracted the existing sessions_spawn implementation into src/agents/subagent-spawn.ts and added a /subagents command caller; the sessions_spawn tool continued to delegate to behavior copied from its pre-existing implementation. That refactor did not create the sandbox downgrade fixed by b9aa2d43, whose guard rejects a sandboxed requester when the resolved child runtime is unsandboxed.

evidence.atomic_binding: git blame at the parent of 49dffa40 maps targetAgentId, allowAgents, and childSessionKey cross-agent logic to human commit 0ba72477; the AI commit relocates that logic.
